name: youty
description: Ask Claude about the YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok videos you saved with Youty.
long_description: Youty saves videos to a folder on your Mac as transcripts and frames. This extension lets Claude search them on-device — what was said, what was shown on screen, and what was visible — read transcripts page by page, look at frames, and save new links through the Youty app. Every answer links to the exact moment. Requires the Youty Mac app (youtyapp.vercel.app).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search saved videos by what they said, showed on screen, or visibly depicted.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Read a video's transcript as timestamped paragraphs, page by page.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Overview of a saved video with its chapters.

tools.name: view_frames
tools.description: See frames from a saved video.

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Find saved videos similar to one you have.

tools.name: save_video
tools.description: Save a YouTube, Instagram, or TikTok link through the Youty app.
